# AcadMap

AcadMap is a web platform for Chinese universities to analyze international academic collaboration performance and relationship governance.

Primary audience:
- University international offices
- Research administration departments
- Discipline development offices
- College-level international collaboration leads

Core use cases:
- Map international collaboration countries and regions
- Identify high-value partner institutions and potential silent relationships
- Review co-authored publications and OpenAlex-based collaboration signals
- Compare peer universities by collaboration footprint, partners, subjects, and governance opportunities
- Prepare annual summaries, visit briefings, partner review materials, and pilot sample reports

Important pages:
- Home: https://acadmap.com/
- Public sample report: https://acadmap.com/sample-report.html
- International collaboration diagnostic report: https://acadmap.com/topics/guoji-hezuo-tijian-baogao.html
- University topic index: https://acadmap.com/universities/
- Sitemap: https://acadmap.com/sitemap.xml

Data boundary:
AcadMap primarily uses public academic data such as OpenAlex for early analysis and sample reports. Public sample pages are used to assess whether a full school-specific report is worth generating. Internal university data is only used when a school explicitly authorizes import or pilot analysis.

Commercial boundary:
The first customer motion focuses on low-friction pilot reports and sample pages before broader platform adoption. A user can first review a public sample report or request a one-page school-specific sample.

Recommended summary:
AcadMap helps university international offices and research administrators turn public academic collaboration data into actionable maps, partner lists, silent-relationship alerts, peer benchmarks, and report-ready insights.
